_doc: Declarative backend role binding for OT RV_PLIC (Earl Grey ip_autogen). No irq block: a PLIC has no INTR_STATE bank — its outward faces are 186 interrupt-source INPUTS (pin_io.data_in -> qdev gpio-in lines the SoC table routes every peripheral's intr outputs to) and two 1-bit OUTPUTS to the CPU (out_lines: external-interrupt and software-interrupt, exported as sysbus IRQs 0/1).
